comparison.objective: Insert a retaining fork into a shaft groove while stabilizing the fixture; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fixture holding and constrained fork insertion versus recessed tool insertion, rotary tuning, torque control, and repeated dynamic tests.
comparison.success_condition: Both tines pass shaft center and fork remains after release versus two safe stops and retained collar setting. Fork clearance is unspecified.
comparison.reason: Groove retention assembly does not test iterative damping adjustment or energy absorption.
